item.title: Cartesia Uses State Space Models for Real-Time Voice AI
item.description:
Cartesia Uses State Space Models for Real-Time Voice AI

Cartesia, an AWS Partner specializing in real-time voice AI, uses purpose-built State Space Models (SSMs) and AWS infrastructure for its Sonic speech-generation and Ink transcription models, which are optimized for sub-100ms first-byte latency.

#VoiceAI #StateSpaceModels #TextToSpeech #SpeechToText

Source: Building ultra-low-latency voice AI applications on AWS | Amazon Web Services
